thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated packet loss detected from POP eu-west-3 -> upstream backbone (obs: 15-40% loss). Auto-escalation to SRE on-call. Links: <https://playbooks.redwood/edge-pop-network|runbook>, <https://dash.redwood/edge/metrics?pop=eu-west-3|metrics>
jamie (oncall): I'm on it. Paging network & infra. Starting triage. Can someone confirm if this is localized to just eu-west-3 or cross-pop? first checks: `curl -I https://status.redwood/api/health` and `mtr -c 10 -r -w edge.eu-west-3.redwood.net`
mira: seeing similar alerts from our synthetic probes. EU frontend 95th p50 latency up, 5xx up from 0.2% -> 8% for eu-region. Customers routing through eu-west-3 impacted.
alex m: pulling BGP and peering stats now. Initial look: a few prefixes from transit-isp-2 are showing high AS path async/drops. snippet:
```
Route: 203.0.113.0/24 via 198.51.100.1 dev eth0
AS path: 64496 3356 1299
Last flap: 2026-06-11T03:12Z

IFStats: txerrs=0 txdrops=0 rxerrs=0 rxdrops=1200
```
alex m: also seeing increased TCP retransmits on the transit handoff (sustained). Could be last-mile ISP flap upstream of our POP.
jamie (oncall): ok let's mark customer-impacting and page support so CS can prepare comms. @cs-alyssa please start collecting impacted customer list.
cs-alyssa: on it. pulling logs for top 50 customers hitting eu endpoints. Will post list in ~10m.
ops-shan: would it be acceptable to fail traffic away from eu-west-3 to eu-west-2 temporarily? We have capacity headroom on eu-west-2 but need to ensure cache-warmth won't tank latencies.
ton y: if we shift routing at the edge, we can do a weighted failover via the edge-router policy. Command to flip (dry-run first):
```
# dry-run
redwood-edgectl route-update --pop eu-west-3 --fallback eu-west-2 --weight 0.2 --dry-run
# apply
redwood-edgectl route-update --pop eu-west-3 --fallback eu-west-2 --weight 0.2
```
mira: +1 for partial shift. Full cut risks cache misses. Start with 20% failover and watch error rates.
jamie (oncall): doing 20% now. will monitor.
incident-bot: action logged: route-update invoked by jamie (oncall) at 1926001205. Dry-run: ok. Applied weight=0.2.
jamie (oncall): after 20% shift: packet loss seen on eu-west-3 egress reduced from 30% -> 18% but overall EU 5xx dropped from 8% -> 5.1%. Still above baseline.
alex m: running targeted traceroutes to upstream transit nodes. Looks like an intermediate hop (AS1299) is queuing packets. I'm opening a ticket with transit-isp-2 NOC and sending them the mtr/traceroute dumps.
ops-shan: can we kick in TCP-proxy fallback for long tail customers? We have a flag to route TCP handshakes through backup path. It's riskier but reduces retransmits.
ton y: we can enable `edge.tcp_proxy.backup=true` for pop eu-west-3 for 30m window.
jamie (oncall): enable it, set 30m, leave monitoring. `edge.tcp_proxy.backup=true` -> applied.
incident-bot: task update: tcp-proxy-backup enabled by tony at 1926001308. Scheduled auto-revert at +30m.
mira: noise reduced. 5xx at 3.2% now. Client perceived latency for impacted flows improved slightly.
cs-alyssa: compiling customer impact: approx 12 large customers saw >5% error rate (AcmeCorp, FinCo, Shoply, EduNet). Estimated requests affected ~9% of EU traffic during peak (12:01-12:12 UTC). Drafting outbound with current mitigation notes.
alex m: transit-isp-2 acknowledged flaps on their peering, they have a mitigation in progress (BGP dampening and interface reset). They expect stabilization in 15-45m.
ev an: quick heads-up: I'm taking over the on-call at 1926001400 for the handoff. jamie, do you have anything to pass through? any follow-ups?
jamie (oncall): handoff notes:
- Mitigation applied: 20% weighted failover to eu-west-2
- Enabled tcp-proxy backup on eu-west-3 for 30m
- BGP issue reported to transit-isp-2 (ticket #TI2-8421)
- Customer impact: ~9% EU traffic affected, top customers identified, CS drafting comms
- Next steps: monitor metrics for 30m, prepare plan to increase failover if asymptomatic. Escalate to network lead if transit doesn't stabilize.
ejan: (typo) meant evan :)
ev an: ack. I'll watch for reversion and coordinate with network. If transit still flaky at 12:40 UTC I'll propose increasing failover to 50% or initiating full drain with cache-warm strategy.
jamie (oncall): thanks. handoff done :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1926001445. Note: customer impact reduced due to mitigations. Auto-update to incident timeline recorded.
cs-alyssa: will send an interim customer note summarizing root cause as upstream transit peering instability and mitigation steps. Draft ready for review.
jamie (oncall): closing my active pager. leaving post-incident follow-ups in the ticketing system: runbook updates, add synthetic probe for AS1299 paths, and update failover playbook.
ev an: taking the thread. will keep ops updated. :eyes:
